review_rounds.findings: origin-only recovery and distinct result/failure terminal refs remained unsafe
pre-publication V7 checks and recovery certificate cross-binding were incomplete
the recovery minimum age and predecessor origin were not protocol-level invariants

reviewed_invariants: V7 source-lock remains immutable and V7 authorization, consumption, result, and failure tags remain permanently absent
source-lock publication validates the V7 origin state before and after V8 tag creation
CAS losers cannot be mistaken for the consumption owner
consumption ownership binds a unique attempt ID and exact consumption tag object SHA
run-start is rechecked against the exact locked commit and full source digest immediately before consumption
result and failure compete for one terminal evidence CAS tag
result and failure SHA-256 and Git blob IDs derive from the same in-memory bytes
orphan recovery binds the actual source-lock, authorization, consumption, commit, source, and terminal evidence chain
orphan recovery requires a six-hour immutable delay, an exact consumption tag object SHA, a non-empty reason, and explicit confirmation that the original process terminated
the fixed reviewer set is freeze_implementation, language_claims, and metrics_controls
